messages:
Amy (Product): Quick sync — customers managing their own network want predictable upgrade behavior. Need acceptance criteria for packaging + upgrade cadence by tomorrow.

Ravi (Eng-Infra): Proposal: minor operator-only patches = in-place, no IP changes. Major upgrades = operator-assisted migration with an explicit maintenance window. Provide `--preserve-egress-ip` flag.

Maria (Field NetOps): Please ensure we have an egress-ip override and docs with sample firewall rules. Customers will not touch NAT unless absolutely required.

Jordan (Solutions): Add a dry-run mode that validates customer manifests and outputs a changelist. That will let field run a preflight with customers.

Bob (Security): KMS handling is critical. Upgrades must do a preflight key-check and emit an audit event. No automatic key rotations unless explicitly requested.

Ravi (Eng-Infra): Implementation sketch: operator flags `--dry-run`, `--preserve-egress-ip`, `--force-restart`. Offline bundles for airgapped sites. Example: `redwood-installer apply --bundle v1.4.1 --preserve-egress-ip --dry-run`.

Jordan (Solutions): Draft acceptance matrix: minors = no IP change; rollback = restore previous version and traffic <15m; offline bundle size <=500MB; operator skew <=2 minor versions.

Maria (Field NetOps): Suggest adding an opt-in "bridge mode" to avoid touching routing tables for strict IP ownership customers. Also three topology examples from field: single-NAT, dual-NAT with egress pinning, and private transit.

deploybot: Preflight step added: `redwoodctl preflight --check-egress` validates egress mapping, firewall hints, and RBAC.

Amy (Product): Actions: Ravi prototype flags + preflight by Thu; Jordan write acceptance tests; Maria collect topology samples; Bob list KMS constraints. Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:

Ravi (Eng-Infra): Ack — will post design sketch and CLI surface in Confluence.

Jordan (Solutions): I'll add dry-run scenarios to the eval harness and staging playbooks.

Amy (Product): If we pass these gates, plan to include in v1.4.1 private deploy. Closing when updates posted.
